CMOS OTA-C band-pass/low-pass biquad
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VIN vin 0 DC 1.65 AC 1
VCM vcm 0 1.65
VB vb 0 .8
XDUT vdd 0 vin vb vcm bp lp astra_075_cmos_ota_c_biquad
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec bias_bp range 1.6 1.7 unit=V
* @spec bias_lp range 1.6 1.7 unit=V
* @spec bp_low range 0.08 0.25 unit=V/V
* @spec bp_mid range 0.8 1.8 unit=V/V
* @spec bp_high range 0.05 0.15 unit=V/V
* @spec lp_low range 0.9 1.15 unit=V/V
* @spec lp_high range 0 0.03 unit=V/V
.control
set filetype=ascii
dc VIN 1.65 1.651 .001
meas dc bias_bp FIND v(bp) AT=1.6505
meas dc bias_lp FIND v(lp) AT=1.6505
ac dec 40 1k 1Meg
let bmag=mag(v(bp))
let lmag=mag(v(lp))
meas ac bp_low FIND bmag AT=5k
meas ac bp_mid FIND bmag AT=50k
meas ac bp_high FIND bmag AT=500k
meas ac lp_low FIND lmag AT=5k
meas ac lp_high FIND lmag AT=500k
write out.raw v(bp) v(lp)
quit
.endc
.end
